approvers: Tax adviser, lawyer, family, house bank
reason: A brand-new Belize shell with no track record and no committed funding is not a buyer I put in front of my adviser. I have built this business for decades and I will not hand it to an offshore company that cannot show it has the money.
objection: Belize holding company, no track record, funding not committed, and 30% of the price paid over three years by a company I cannot check. I could end up with nothing and a damaged business.
instead: Let my adviser run a proper process, use nexxt-change, and talk to buyers who can show proof of funds, such as a trade competitor or an MBI with a bank letter. Or keep running the business a few more years.
would_change_my_mind: A bank-confirmed letter of funds for the full price, a German or EU entity with references from earlier deals, and a bank guarantee or escrow for the deferred 30%.
